---
title: "Y2H X-Gal quantification"
---

# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(FSA)
library(svglite)
library(png)
library(patchwork)

source(here("Functions", "Y2H-Xgal-analysis_functions.R"))
```

## File handling

```{r}
#| label: selecting file
#| eval: false
#| include: false

InputFilePath <- file.choose()
```

```{r}
#| label: "collecting data"

Data <- read.csv(InputFilePath)
Data$Combination <- factor(Data$Combination)
Data$OD <- factor(Data$OD)
```

# Visualsation

```{r}
P1 <- PanelPlot(Data, "1", TRUE)
P2 <- PanelPlot(Data, "0.1")
P3 <- PanelPlot(Data, "0.01", FALSE, TRUE)

Panel <- P1 + P2 + P3 + plot_layout(ncol = 3, widths = c(1,1,1))

png(filename = gsub(".csv", ".png", InputFilePath), width = 3500, height = 1500, units = "px", res = 400)
print(Panel)
dev.off()
```
